about: Holding a particle of the Host over the chalice, the priest signs the chalice three times with it and gives the greeting of peace. The server answers.

seg.nr: Holding the particle over the chalice, the priest makes three signs of the cross with it.

seg.tr: May the peace of the Lord always be with you.

fn.w005: Ablative plural of vos with -cum attached.

fn.w008: An ablative after “cum” (w007), in the response “Et cum spíritu tuo”.
